business_problem: Holiday Extras needed to scale multilingual marketing, support, data fluency, engineering productivity, and customer assistance across a travel-tech business without adding comparable manual effort.
solution_summary: Holiday Extras rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise across every team and used it to build a more data-driven, efficient operating model. Marketing teams now translate and localize large volumes of copy in many European languages far faster than before, while non-technical staff can upload CSVs to identify trends instead of depending entirely on SQL-savvy colleagues. Engineers use ChatGPT for debugging, thought partnership, and communication, and designers created a UX Scoring GPT that combines authoritative UX principles with internal guidance to score pages and recommend improvements. Customer support also shifted: an AI bot now handles a meaningful share of inquiries before humans engage, reducing costs while improving satisfaction. Beyond employee-facing use cases, Holiday Extras launched Syd AI to help travelers understand insurance policies and is building an ultra-personalized super app on OpenAI’s API so recommendations can become unique to each trip. The program combines broad weekly usage with measurable savings across time, support costs, and engineering output.

data_flow: Employee tasks such as copy localization, CSV analysis, SQL assistance, debugging, and UX review flow into ChatGPT Enterprise and custom GPTs. Customer inquiries move through AI support and Syd AI before escalation, while trip and policy context is prepared for future recommendation workflows on top of the OpenAI API.
business_outcome: Holiday Extras saved hundreds of hours per week, raised customer satisfaction, increased engineering and analytics productivity, and created a base for more personalized AI experiences across the traveler journey.
